notes: PROPOSAL only, not enqueued (worker does NOT create tasks via taskctl). The B120 guard (audit_review_artifact_strictness_b120_v1.py) is a deterministic, read-only, static-file strictness screen over a fixed 3-wave manifest (KNOWN_WAVES).
